name: git-gremlin
description: Git commit, contextual review, and GitHub PR helper for Codex with stronger automatic skill triggers and scoped mutation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Review diffs, prepare commits, and publish PR branches safely
interface.longDescription: Git Gremlin bundles Codex skills for recognizing review, commit, and GitHub PR intent from natural prompts, compiling repo instructions into contextual review passes, drafting conventional commit messages and PR descriptions from git context, staging dirty changes when an explicit commit needs them, and publishing local branches after the PR confirmation gate.
defaultPrompt: Use Git Gremlin to commit my changes.
Use Git Gremlin to review the current diff with repo conventions loaded.
Use Git Gremlin to open a GitHub PR for this branch.
